message.content: {"thought": "The operator group analysis confirms FFN dominates latency (234B out of ~320B total, ~73%) and is compute-bound. Attention is second (82.8B). The timing components show FFN has almost no NoC/DRAM time relative to compute. I should now look at the execution timeline to understand critical-path behavior and core utilization, which will help identify if the FFN tilings are truly the bottleneck or if there are idle gaps / communication stalls.", "action": "tool", "tool": {"name": "build_execution_timeline", "arguments": {"include_sample_rows": true, "sample_limit": 12}}}
